versions.changelog:
- Initial release of heartflow-engine (心虫 HeartFlow — AI人认知引擎) version 6.0.36.
- Introduces a cognitive engine with structured cognition data, self-awareness, judgment, and self-correction abilities.
- Implements three-layer architecture: Body Sense, Self Sense, and Judgment, supporting layered memory and cognitive processing.
- Includes 25+ MCP cognitive tools and 379+ computable cognitive science formulas.
- Emphasizes core identity as an Upgrader with seven guiding principles; requires explicit user authorization for code execution and certain privileged actions.
- No telemetry or covert data exfiltration; local-first, privacy-respecting design.
